title: [Bug]: AgentScope Bash tool misclassifies "tee" as a read-only command, allowing arbitrary file write without user confirmation (CWE-863, CVSS 8.1)
body: I'd like to pick up the still-open second half of this report — the `extract_file_paths()` gap — since the first item (`tee` in `SAFE_COMMANDS`) is already fixed on `main` and #3347 was closed without…
